name: pm-guidelines
description: Cross-project PM best practices enforcement — 691 guidelines, 16 skills, 7 agents, 9 hooks (7 quality checks in single dispatcher + 2 PreToolUse guards). v1.8.0 adds Tier 1 operationalization of lessons #746-#776: frozen-artifact guard (extends source_file_protection with .pm-frozen-paths config — blocks edits to FROZEN HTML files like PMO Dashboard v10/v11/v12/v13/v14 + STP v3-v8); electron_renderer_check PreToolUse hook (blocks window.prompt/alert/confirm + renderer-side localhost fetch in Electron renderer files; warns on new ipcMain.handle); pm-multi-version-clone skill (3-rule v[N-1]→v[N] HTML clone hygiene); pm-cross-dashboard-drift agent (audits stale jump-list hrefs + localhost port drift + new Date(+'Z') NaN traps); pm-coverage-matrix skill (3-rule discipline: matrix-before-create, AskUserQuestion-options, delete-with-migration). Earlier versions: v1.7.0 added pm-data-readiness skill + pm-link-auditor agent.
